verdict.rationale: TaxJar imports sales from marketplace channels such as Amazon FBA and eBay, tracks economic nexus thresholds, and offers AutoFile filing and remittance. This implies marketplace sales can feed nexus tracking and reporting. However, nothing in the evidence shows it recognizes facilitator-collected tax or excludes those sales from remittance. Missing for 10: explicit marketplace-facilitator handling, exclusion of facilitator-collected tax from returns, documentation on counting facilitator sales toward nexus, independent corroboration.
